title: Inside KeyDrift: Analyzing historical UAT-11473 activity on Cisco SD-WAN
description: Cisco Talos identified UAT-11473, an advanced persistent threat actor exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication bypass in Cisco SD-WAN Catalyst Controller instances. The attacker deployed a custom malware framework named KeyDrift, designed to persistently access and exfiltrate sensitive keying material from SD-WAN control-plane processes. KeyDrift includes components such as PolyFlame, which injects into legitimate controller processes to intercept decrypted control traffic, and LittleFilch, which collects and stages keying material for exfiltration. The malware operates stealthily within the controller environment, leveraging modified service scripts and runit service paths for persistence and execution. Targeting spans space and satellite services, defense, aerospace, and policy research sectors. The threat actor's infrastructure overlaps with the Volt Typhoon group’s covert network.
